plan.disposition: small complexity — plan/external/plan-internal review is medium+ only per SKILL.md Phase Matrix

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: pendingNarration surviving past a test/user-input-only turn is safe because it only ever reaches the very next real turn. — Concrete transcript: narration -> several test-only retries -> a turn with no narration of its own that pivots to unrelated work (e.g. Write emailTemplate.ts). The unrelated turn's card inherited the stale narration text describing the earlier, unrelated investigation. FIXED: pendingNarration now carries a staleness counter (MAX_PENDING_NARRATION_CARRY) and is dropped in favor of the existing generic/label-derived fallback once it has survived too many non-consuming turns, instead of being carried forward indefinitely.
findings.suggestion: Bound the carry-forward with a staleness counter; verified fixed and covered by missionActivityFeed.splitTurn.test.ts's DROPPED-not-misattributed case.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: MAX_PENDING_NARRATION_CARRY = 3 bridges 3 consecutive non-consuming turns to a following real turn, as its doc comment claimed. — Hand-traced the arithmetic: the staleness increment and the drop check both happen on the SAME non-consuming turn, so pendingNarration is nulled ON the 3rd such turn, not after it -- the constant actually bridges only 2 turns, one fewer than its own value and one fewer than the comment's 'handful of test turns' claim. FIXED: bumped the constant to 4 (bridging 3 turns, matching a realistic 3-retry test-until-green burst) and corrected the comment to state the bridged count is the constant minus one.
findings.suggestion: Corrected the constant and its doc comment; verified fixed and covered by missionActivityFeed.splitTurn.test.ts's 'survives THREE consecutive non-consuming turns' case.
